title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin holds $63,935 after a 1.6% overnight lift even as Fear & Greed sits at 25 in extreme fear. Hashrate remains firm at 793.7 EH/s while the mempool backs up to 92,546 transactions with fees as low as 2 sat/vB. Asia flows showed quiet accumulation into the open. Watch for any break above 64,500 that could flip sentiment and clear the backlog, or fresh downside pressure if macro headlines hit before the Wall Street open.
